text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained enqueue backlog on GPU pool 'render-fleet-2' >90% for 6m. Autoscaler reports repeated provider quota failures. Paging oncall-sre. https://ops.redwood/alert/1740032100

oncall-sre: acknowledged, moving to #incidents-live. Who's seeing customer impact?

maya (SRE): Observed 95k queued requests, tail latency climbing >12s, 5xx up to 6.8%. Multiple nodes reporting kernel oops and CUDA/Xid 43 resets. Affected route: /v1/generate (rwd-chat-1).

raj (eng-runtime): Confirming node flaps. Driver logs show repeated gpu reset stacks and then kube marking pods NotReady. Autoscaler attempts CreateInstance but returns quotaExceeded errors from cloud provider. Example:
```
2025-07-03T21:12:05Z autoscaler ERROR create: RequestLimitExceeded: region us-west-1 GPU quota reached
2025-07-03T21:12:11Z kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 43, GPU has fallen off the bus
```

li (eng-ml): Workload skewed to long-context completion; each request pins GPU for longer than usual. Queue compounding because autoscaler can't add capacity.

eva (customer-success): Two paid customers reported timeouts and slow responses. I've opened tickets and told them we're on it. Potential SLA impact for tier-1 customers.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigations list: (A) divert non-critical routes to alternate region pool; (B) temporarily enforce stricter rate-limiting per-user; (C) restart drivers on flapping nodes; (D) pause autoscaler to avoid thrashing. Rank by customer impact reduction.

raj (eng-runtime): Doing A and D in parallel. Spinning up 10 nodes in us-east-2 for low-priority traffic. Pausing autoscaler on render-fleet-2: `kubectl annotate pool/render-fleet-2 autoscaler=paused --overwrite`

ops-bot: ACTION: autoscaler paused on render-fleet-2 by raj at 2025-07-03T21:18:40Z :white_check_mark:

maya (SRE): Restarting driver on two worst nodes now. Runbook snippet:
```
for n in gpu-07 gpu-12; do ssh $n 'sudo systemctl stop kubelet; sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm nvidia; sudo modprobe nvidia && sudo systemctl start kubelet'; done
```

raj (eng-runtime): Manual capacity in us-east-2 up. Route updates: low-priority routes bumped to us-east-2 via traffic-split. High-priority customers remain on stable us-west nodes.

li (eng-ml): Note: because of long sequences, batching config change won't help the current backlog; moving traffic helps reduce new enqueues only.

eva (customer-success): Communicated mitigation plan to customers and offered temporary throughput reduction option for degraded sessions. Logging P1 for affected enterprise.

oncall-sre: after driver restarts + manual capacity: queued requests fell from 95k -> 20k in 10m; 5xx dropped to ~1.5%. Node Ready count increased from 7 -> 18. Good initial signs.

raj (eng-runtime): Opened cloud quota request REQ-9912 for emergency GPU quota bump in us-west-1 (blocking autoscaler growth). Also created hotfix branch to pin kernel/driver module versions that avoid this Xid pattern (PR #4381).

maya (SRE): We're leaving autoscaler paused until hotfix validated. Schedule: canary patch on 5 nodes, 2h watch for Xid/oom, then wider rollout.

oncall-sre: adding operational notes: do not unpause autoscaler until REQ-9912 is approved or hotfix reduces resets by >90%. Postmortem owner = maya. Severity: Sev2 (partial regional degradation, customer impact).

natalie (SRE): taking night shift handoff at 2025-07-04T03:00Z. Will monitor metrics and ensure autoscaler remains paused. Please add any playbook updates to the incident doc.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: backlog 18k, 5xx 1.1%, manual capacity +10 nodes in us-east-2, autoscaler paused, owner maya.

oncall-sre: closing active paging state. Keep channel open for updates from quota request and hotfix rollout. Thanks team. :heart:
